responsibility: Declares the shared base class for Rust HIR type-checking components. TypeCheckBase centralizes access to mappings, name resolution, and TypeCheckContext, and exposes reusable helpers for trait-bound predicate construction, literal typing, repr parsing, unconstrained-generic checks, generic-parameter setup, and the standard unify/coercion/cast checking sites used throughout item, expression, statement, and type resolution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the common TypeCheckBase helper class and its reusable utility entry points for other HIR typechecking passes. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-base.cc, it defines the shared interface and stored context accessors, not the implementations of literal resolution, repr parsing, or unify/coercion/cast helpers.
